about_the_game:
Snailmail is a multiplayer delivery game where you and your friends take on the role of snails running competing post offices. The town is divided into neighborhoods, and each post office is responsible for delivering letters and packages to its assigned houses.

Each day brings new deliveries of varying size and difficulty. Small letters are quick and easy, while heavier parcels will slow you down and test your route planning. To succeed, you’ll need to follow the rules of the road.
Speeding, running lights, or causing trouble will cost you in fines and reduce your earnings. Delivering late will also mean smaller payouts.

At the end of the day, all players return to their post offices to tally their profits. Money can be spent to:

  • Expand your territory by bidding on new streets and houses.

  • Upgrade your office and equipment to deliver more efficiently.

  • Sabotage rivals and make their deliveries harder.

But beware: every territory you want to claim must be defended. Other players can outbid you, and the competition grows more intense as the town fills up.

Will you build the most efficient snail-powered delivery empire, or get left in the slime trail of your rivals?
